tools.name: list_monitors
tools.description: List all OmniWatchGuard monitors of the authenticated user, with the number of changes in the last 7 days and the last detected change.

tools.name: get_monitor
tools.description: Get the full details of one monitor and its last 20 check results.

tools.name: create_monitor
tools.description: Create a new monitor for a web page. Types: text, price, stock, css, api, seo, ssl (tech_stack and whois need the matching add-on). The number of monitors and the available check intervals depend on the user's plan.

tools.name: update_monitor
tools.description: Update fields of an existing monitor: name, URL, selector, check interval or price/stock thresholds.

tools.name: set_monitor_status
tools.description: Pause or resume an existing monitor.

tools.name: list_alerts
tools.description: List the latest alerts sent to the user (email, webhook, Slack, Discord, Telegram), with details of the change that triggered each one.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_monitor, update_monitor, list_alerts · Public sink: list_alerts · Destructive: delete_monitor.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_monitor, update_monitor, list_alerts · Public sink: list_alerts · Destructive: delete_monitor

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
